top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Surge in 'risk-free' treasury yields sends bond investors in search of better opportunities
top_signals.impact: Treasury yield surge shows bond market is not 'risk free' after all, but there's opportunity for fixed-income investors in intermediates, BBBs and high yield.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: How Bond Yield Surge Will Impact Economies, Markets
top_signals.impact: A prolonged period of elevated long-term bond yields is ramping up borrowing costs around the world. That’s because investors are demanding more and more compensation for holding government debt after the war in Iran ignited fresh inflation fears and concerns…

top_signals.headline: Fed officials see rate hike ahead if inflation stays elevated, minutes show
top_signals.impact: A majority of officials anticipated that interest rate increases would be necessary if the Iran war continued to aggravate inflation.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: Traders are making big moves ahead of these earnings reports due Thursday
top_signals.impact: With Nvidia earnings in the rearview mirror, traders have a handful of earnings before and after the bell to trade on Thursday.

top_signals.headline: Two top Walmart executives leave company under new CEO John Furner
top_signals.impact: Tom Ward, chief operating officer of Walmart's warehouse chain Sam's Club, is retiring, and Cedric Clark, Walmart's EVP of U.S. store operations, is leaving.

top_signals.headline: The oil shock meets the Fed ‘curse’: What Kevin Warsh means for your portfolio
top_signals.impact: Market downturns typically tag new central-bank leaders. And Warsh faces a tough choice between crushing demand or saving the bull market.

top_signals.headline: Kevin Warsh walks into a trap where the Fed can’t cut rates even if it wants to
top_signals.impact: Kevin Warsh is becoming Federal Reserve chair at a pivotal moment for the U.S. economy — forcing him to be something other than the disruptor he hoped to be.

top_signals.headline: Disney's 'Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu' tallies lowest Thursday preview sales in franchise history
top_signals.impact: Disney's "Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu" tallied $12 million in Thursday night previews, the lowest collection of advanced tickets in franchise history.

top_signals.headline: Stocks continue surging to record highs. Here's how to hedge
top_signals.impact: The rally back to records has made buying protection more affordable.

top_signals.headline: Arm shares extend weekly rally to almost 50%, and Starbucks pulls the plug on an AI project
top_signals.impact: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

top_signals.headline: Trump said he'd 'remember' companies that didn't apply for tariff refunds. Many of them are anyway
top_signals.impact: Walmart confirmed to CNBC it has sought a tariff refund and plans to use any money it receives back to invest in lower prices for shoppers.

top_signals.headline: Wall Street thinks IMAX is ripe for a sale. Here's who could buy it
top_signals.impact: A source told CNBC that IMAX has held "preliminary talks" through intermediaries, but no official pitches have been made by the company.

top_signals.headline: Egg prices are plunging due to oversupply — and producers say margins are taking a hit as costs rise
top_signals.impact: Egg prices are plunging from oversupply after avian flu shortages, but producers say persistent feed, fuel and labor costs are squeezing margins.

top_signals.headline: The Club's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Friday
top_signals.impact: Stocks are poised to extend yesterday's gains.

top_signals.headline: What the AvalonBay, Equity Residential megamerger means for the apartment industry and rents
top_signals.impact: The deal will create one of the largest real estate companies in the U.S., with more than 180,000 rental apartments.
